title: A routed ask leaves the waiting page's Ask area by the rule the owner picks
why: The Ask area is too crowded, and the owner rarely reads it, so asks that already have a home hide the ones that need his eyes.
note: Owner comment on the Ask area, thread b2ff97bf (09:11 CST Nov 10, relayed by the coordinator  CST): asks must not be ephemeral; each becomes a page question or a roadmap step plus a short reply. Blocked on page item 480 (ask-phase-out-rule), which asks how an ask leaves the area.
